messages.text:
The ZIP fixtures are AES-encrypted, so the standard `zipfile` decryption path is insufficient for the benchmark’s core files.

The reference only needs the AES password-verification bytes before attempting extraction, so I’m adding that AES header parsing and PBKDF2 check directly in the Python port.
